title: bug: postflight-worktree.cjs marker-scan fails on the sh engine when the fixture parent is on drvfs (/mnt/d): mkfifo is unsupported there
description: Repro (WSL, HEAD 0d8422ce): S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/x.XXXXXX); git archive HEAD scripts | tar -x -C "$S"; MOE_WORKTREE_ONLY=marker-scan node "$S/scripts/tests/postflight-worktree.cjs" sh "$S/scripts/moe-agent.sh" "$S/scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js" "$S" "$(command -v bash)" → "marker-scan FAILED: Error: Command failed: mkfifo …: Operation not supported". The same case passes with an ext4 parent (/tmp). Any WSL gate that puts the sh leg's parent on /mnt/d, which it must do to share one snapshot with the node.exe ps1 leg, fails at HEAD (seen in task-31187ec1's planned verification). Fix idea: make the fifo element conditional on mkfifo succeeding (or create it under os.tmpdir()), without weakening the scan's assertions.
reopenReason: Human "move from backlog": worker-filed real bug with repro (postflight-worktree.cjs mkfifo on drvfs); test-harness only; promote for planning.
